recipe.visualDefinition: A 1960s soul music album cover featuring a multi-ethnic group of men standing in front of a modern concrete building, characterized by a prominent yellow header banner with psychedelic lettering and a dark vertical sidebar for track listings.
coreVisualRelationships: The yellow header banner anchors the top third and contains the primary branding.
The vertical dark sidebar on the right balances the horizontal header.
The central photographic subject uses a low-angle perspective to emphasize the group's presence.
The architectural background provides a neutral, structured grid against the organic human forms.
coreInvariants: Yellow rectangular banner with decorative corner flourishes
High-contrast vertical sidebar for secondary text
1960s-era menswear including cardigans, slacks, and sunglasses

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body group portrait centered in the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow header banner at the top edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold yellow header, moves down through the group members, and finishes on the right-hand tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Utilized in the sky area and the flat concrete surfaces of the building to prevent clutter.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm neutrals (beige, concrete grey) in the photography.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and navy in the clothing and the right-hand sidebar.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant mustard yellow for the primary title banner.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements (yellow) contrasted with the desaturated, naturalistic tones of the photo.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or digital-first colors; stick to earthy, printed ink tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with liquid, psychedelic distortions.
letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing with occasional overlaps
Inverted contrast where horizontal strokes are thicker than vertical ones
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'V' and 'A' in the main title feature flared, wing-like terminals.
The 'S' has a heavy, bulbous bottom curve.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between expressive, liquid display lettering and rigid, functional sans-serif metadata.
graphicDevices: Decorative banner frame with corner nodes

preserve: The liquid/psychedelic style of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, curved, bottom-weighted feel of the 60s display type.
Appropriate for the utilitarian tracklist text in the sidebar.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A group portrait of five men in 1960s attire standing in front of a mid-century modern concrete apartment building with balconies. Leave a solid yellow rectangular bar at the top and a dark brown vertical bar on the right side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold, psychedelic blue-grey lettering inside the yellow banner. Add a list of song titles in white geometric sans-serif in the right-hand sidebar.

verificationChecks: Is the yellow banner the brightest element?
Does the display font have a 'melting' or liquid appearance?
Is the sidebar text aligned to the left and clearly legible?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and track titles
Specific facial features of the individuals

mustAchieve: Structured layout with clear graphic zones
avoid: Generic sans-serif for the main title

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow banner has the decorative corner flourishes.
Check that the display type is thick and fills the banner height.
Verify the right sidebar is a distinct, solid color block.
Confirm the photography has a vintage film grain or slight desaturation.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [Subject] in [Setting] with a [Color] header banner containing [Psychedelic Style] lettering and a [Contrast Color] sidebar for [List Content].
